scope_note: 3'UTR-anchored: both primers lie in the LDHA 3'UTR and fully match 6 LDHA RefSeq transcripts (incl. NM_005566.4), so the assay reports aggregate LDHA transcript abundance rather than a single isoform. CDS-anchoring was infeasible because LOC105375980 (NR_202040.1) carries 96.16% of the LDHA CDS and would co-amplify; this pair does not co-amplify LOC105375980 (BLAST LOC hits = 0).
